تنتجبن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَجِبْنَ (tantajibna) /tan.ta.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# تُنْتَجَبْنَ (tuntajabna) /tun.ta.d͡ʒab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
